question: In Table Tennis, how many lets are allowed in a row on a serve?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Unlimited**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• All players are allowed unlimited let serves in table tennis.
 
• There is **no limit to let serves in table tennis.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Important terms of Table tennis:**

 
 
• Rally- Rally is a term used in Tennis. The period in which the ball is in play.
 
• Let- Service ball hitting the net or a distraction that causes the point played over.
 
• Point- A unit of scoring in table tennis.
 
• Dead - A ball without any spin.
